sources.games: 480 league games since 7.40 (7.41 alone had under 300) (data/heroes/item_stats), win 44.6%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py medusa.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Mjollnir, Eye of Skadi, Aghanim's Scepter.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-19: against illusions Maelstrom, then Mjollnir, and Aghanim's Scepter; Mana Shield instead of BKB.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Medusas: 28% of 51 games against them (9% otherwise), won 50% against 40%.

rules.name: Maelstrom

reason.en: {enemy} fights with illusions: start with {item}, its chain lightning on your attacks hits them in groups, then Mjollnir
reason.uk: {enemy} б'ється ілюзіями: почніть із {item} — його ланцюгова блискавка з ваших атак б'є їх групами, — потім Mjollnir

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Maelstrom's Chain Lightning procs on attacks and jumps between enemies; it upgrades into Mjollnir. High-rank Medusas against illusion heroes: Maelstrom 45% of 31 games against them (5% otherwise), won 43% against 29%. The player review: Maelstrom, then Mjollnir, and Aghanim's Scepter too.

rules.name: Mjollnir

reason.en: {enemy} fights with illusions: upgrade your Maelstrom into {item}, its lightning hits them more often
reason.uk: {enemy} б'ється ілюзіями: Maelstrom зберіть у {item} — блискавка б'є їх частіше

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Mjollnir's Chain Lightning procs on attacks and jumps between enemies (Split Shot's extra arrows carry no attack effects, the main target's does). High-rank Medusas against illusion heroes: Mjollnir 36% of 31 games against them (3% otherwise), won 46% against 30%; Maelstrom 45% of 31 games against them (5% otherwise), won 43% against 29%.

rules.name: Aghanim's Scepter

reason.en: {enemy} fights with illusions: {item} lets every Split Shot arrow carry your Mjollnir and attack effects, and adds arrows
reason.uk: {enemy} б'ється ілюзіями: з {item} кожна стріла Split Shot несе Mjollnir та інші ефекти атаки, і стріл більше

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Medusa's Aghanim's Scepter: on-hit effects apply to the secondary attacks of Split Shot and the arrow count grows. High-rank Medusas against illusion heroes: Aghanim's Scepter 36% of 31 games against them (13% otherwise), won 54% against 25%.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. High-rank Medusas against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 44% of 39 games against them (8% otherwise), won 41% against 32%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 94% (-1), null_talisman 65% (2), power_treads 99% (6), yasha 99% (11), manta 99% (15), butterfly 90% (22), skadi 64% (28), diffusal_blade 21% (28), lesser_crit 53% (30), aghanims_shard 42% (32), greater_crit 36% (32), ultimate_scepter 20% (39).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 75.0%+: 20:00 13000 (31 games, 77.4%), 25:00 17500 (60 games, 76.7%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold. No 85% line for this hero (two of the three minutes needed): the hero's own 75% line (scripts/hero_item_stats.py WIN_TARGETS).

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

skills.basis: 480 games: maxed medusa_mystic_snake > medusa_split_shot > medusa_gorgon_grasp 234 (win 51.3%), medusa_mystic_snake > medusa_split_shot 93 (win 26.9%), medusa_split_shot > medusa_mystic_snake > medusa_gorgon_grasp 90 (win 48.9%); talents 10: Stone Gaze Bonus Physical Damage 428/479 (44.6%), Gorgon's Grasp Radius 51/479 (43.1%); 15: Mystic Snake Cooldown 155/224 (44.5%), Gorgon's Grasp Volley 69/224 (50.7%); 20: Split Shot Outgoing Damage 399/408 (48.9%), Mystic Snake Damage / Mana Gain 9/408 (55.6%); 25: +40 Intelligence 34/42 (58.8%), Stone Gaze Duration 8/42 (75.0%).

suppress.magic: Mana Shield absorbs 98% of the damage taken for her mana (2 damage per point, Valve 7.41f); the player review: Mana Shield is enough, no Black King Bar against magic damage.
